summary: OpenAI publishes an audit finding that roughly 30% of tasks in the SWE-Bench Pro coding benchmark are broken due to overly strict tests, underspecified prompts, low test coverage, or misleading prompts, and retracts its earlier recommendation to adopt the benchmark.

practices.reason: Teams currently relying on SWE-Bench Pro to evaluate coding models should stop trusting raw pass-rate results and re-examine flagged tasks before drawing capability conclusions.
practices.quote: we estimate that ~30% of SWE-bench Pro tasks are broken, and advise that model developers carefully examine results.
